name: Haus Wiesenblick
beschreibung: The Haus Wiesenblick welcomes guests to a sunny, peaceful setting in Sölden in the Ötztal, nestled among lush alpine meadows with expansive views of the Ötztal Alps. Styled in classic warm alpine woodwork, the comfortable rooms and holiday apartments feature contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies overlooking the surrounding mountain panorama. A generous morning breakfast buffet packed with regional Tyrolean produce ensures a great start to the day. The valley terminals of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl cable cars, alongside Sölden's lively town centre, are reached in just minutes via the complimentary ski bus. In summer, idyllic hiking footpaths and the famed Bike Republic Sölden trails are immediately accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy bed and breakfast in Sölden in the Ötztal offering rooms with alpine meadow views, Wi-Fi, and near the lifts.
